item.title: Social Good under Transformation: New Contexts for Social Entrepreneurship
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks to advance understanding of social entrepreneurship in rapidly transforming global contexts. We invite submissions that explore how social enterprises are adapting to new economic, technological, and social environments while maintaining their commitment to social and environmental impact.

Potential topics

  • Social entrepreneurship in evolving markets and contexts
  • Impact measurement and evaluation of social enterprises
  • Hybrid business models combining social and commercial goals
  • Digital transformation and social entrepreneurship
  • Policy and regulatory frameworks for social enterprises
  • Stakeholder engagement and partnerships in social entrepreneurship
  • Scaling social impact
  • Environmental sustainability and social entrepreneurship

Timeline

  • October 31, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
